feats.name: Alert
feats.mechanics:
Danger doesn't easily catch you off guard. You gain the following benefits.

*Initiative Proficiency.* When you roll Initiative, you can add your proficiency bonus to the roll.

*Initiative Swap.* Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat.
feats.lore: You've learned to trust your senses and stay alert to danger, whether from a lurking predator or a rival adventuring party.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.mechanics:
You've mastered the fundamentals of crafting, granting you the following benefits.

*Tool Proficiency.* You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.

*Discount.* Whenever you buy a nonmagical item from a business, you receive a 20 percent discount on it.
feats.lore: You spend much of your free time in workshops, turning raw materials into finished goods.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.mechanics: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard spell list, choosing the same class each time. You also learn one 1st-level spell from that class's spell list. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of the spells you learned with this feat with a different eligible spell. The spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for Bard, Sorcerer, or Warlock; Wisdom for Cleric or Druid; or Intelligence for Wizard.
feats.lore: You've studied minor magic passed down from those who came before you.

feats.name: Fade Away
feats.mechanics: You can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Reaction, triggered by taking damage. This benefit lasts until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this feat, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a spell slot to use it again.
feats.lore: Gnomish resilience runs deeper than most realize; when threatened, some gnomes simply vanish.

feats.name: Weapon Master
feats.mechanics:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, granting you the following benefits.

*Weapon Proficiency.* You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

*Bonus Proficiency.* Whenever you gain the Ability Score Improvement feat, you can replace one of your weapon proficiencies from this feat with a different one.
feats.lore: Whether through formal training or countless hours of practice, you've become adept with an array of weapons.
